task.title: Repair verified role-only archive resurrection in the existing TaskStore contract

clause_1_plan_report_preservation.detail: Copied immutable ARCHIVE_RESURRECTION_SA_SD.md and LEGACY_CLOSEOUT_RECONCILIATION.md into docs/04/pantheon_first_release_closure_2026-09-06/ matching exact SHA256 hashes byte-for-byte. Updated INDEX.md to reference both documents.

clause_2_single_reconciliation_authority.detail: Extended existing reconcile_merged_done and _validated_same_delivery_archive_recovery in scripts/ai_status.py; did not create any secondary reconciler, store, or queue.

clause_3_strict_proof_requirements.detail: Enforces exact merged original delivery/review, byte-preserved archive snapshot, identical scope contract (spec hash, acceptance, artifacts, dependencies, dev_bridge, execution_authorization), and complete authenticated ordered lineage chain (audit events) proving stale role-only resurrection.

clause_4_archive_and_generation_preserva.detail: Preserves original archive bytes and terminal fact generation (g1); retires only the proved stale active row (g2); records retired row digest and generation in append-only activity log.

clause_5_preflight_cas_binding.detail: Preflight CAS binds task, generation, spec hash, task digest, archive digest, delivery, and audit proof range; revalidates inside authoritative transaction; excludes live worker/lease/queue.

clause_6_idempotent_retirement_and_recur.detail: Uses existing archive outbox/receipt/recovery ordering for idempotent crash-safe retirement. Blocks recurrence at admission/reassignment boundaries (command_assign, command_reopen, dev_bridge_materialize); preserves existing empty-genesis fail-closed behavior in seed_task_state_v2.py.

clause_7_execution_auth_boundary_preserv.detail: Preserves accepted execution-authorization and retired-review trust boundaries from predecessors. Archive recovery does not acquire or clear privileged authority, merge packet-source trust into MFA trust, or require product login for local maintenance.

clause_8_positive_fixtures_and_crash_rec.detail: Positive fixtures with genuine isolated command runtime and git ancestry, executing real isolated CLI invocations (ai_status.py show, reconcile_merged_done, and recover) without in-process mocks; authenticated import provenance with mandatory exact bindings (generation, archive_generation, owner, reviewer, archive_snapshot_sha256, operator_mode: 'local_human_ops', agent: 'Human/Ops') and authenticated event_id against payload digest; deterministic real-process barriers covering mutation and active worker claim between preflight and commit; crash interruption before commit (SIGKILL before commit lock sync) and after commit (pending outbox), restart recovery, proof-change refusal, outbox receipt convergence, and idempotent recovery with exact byte, generation, and archive checks.

clause_9_zero_effect_negatives.detail: Zero-effect negatives verified for unauthenticated import (missing event_id, unauthorized actor, missing or invalid operator_mode, missing/mismatched generation, archive_generation, owner, reviewer, archive_snapshot_sha256, unauthenticated event_id digest), corrupt/malformed runtime structures (dict or list workers, queue, leases, supervisor reservations with launch_intent), active review invalidation/rejection, intervening new work, nonoperator invocations, and concurrent CAS/proof forks.

clause_10_clean_worktree_base.detail: Task worktree based on dev tip e9d1a1e50b4f098db6e62c1c4e247f1f40f36827 with clean scoped artifacts.

clause_11_governed_delivery.detail: Commit, push branch task/OPS-ARCHIVE-RESURRECTION-CONTRACT-001, PR #5634, independent review by Codex2, required checks, dev merge.

clause_12_ppl_alloc_007_ground_truth_hol.detail: Live canonical task PPL-ALLOC-007 evaluated against canonical state and archive: reports eligible: false, reason: 'stale resurrection lineage missing authoritative import/re-entry event: PPL-ALLOC-007', perfectly preserving the hold without live mutation.

clause_13_ppl_alloc_009_hold_preserved.detail: PPL-ALLOC-009 remains an evidence-only hosted hold under genuine temporary authorization hold; original acceptance clauses and dependencies are unchanged. No runnable ownership restored or hosted execution triggered.
